messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-67890 - model-catalog: unexpected tokenizer change on production variant for model 'instruct-light' (observed error spike).
incident-bot: Summary: default catalog entry for model 'instruct-light' shows `tokenizer: byte_bpe_v2` but the deployed container expects `tokenizer: byte_bpe_v1`. Clients receiving garbled tokens and some 500s. Detected by response-validation rule `tokenizer_consistency_v1`.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-67890 fired at 2024-10-05T10:12:25Z. Initial severity: P1.
sara (oncall): Acked. I'll take first look. @matt can you confirm whether catalog promotion ran in the last 10m? :eyes:
matt (eng-runtime): Looking. I see a promotion job ran at 10:08 UTC from CI: catalog-promote-job-qa->prod. Logs show config diff applied. Pulling the applied manifest now.
matt (eng-runtime): pasted config diff:```json
{
  "model": "instruct-light",
  "variant": "default",
  "pinned_revision": "rev-42",
  "defaults": {
    "tokenizer": "byte_bpe_v2",
    "max_tokens": 1024
  }
}
```
jun (eng-sre): Can we surface the previous production manifest? We need to compare. If v2 is incompatible we should rollback to rev-41 defaults.
sara (oncall): Laura, any CS hits reported?
laura (cs): We're seeing 3 customers in monitoring with ~20 failed requests each, mostly right after 10:09 UTC. One reported "weird characters in responses". No legal/regulatory customers affected so far. Informing affected accounts.
matt (eng-runtime): Checked deployed task metadata: runtime container for `instruct-light:rev-42` packages tokenizer code pinned to `byte_bpe_v1`. So runtime/tokenizer mismatch for requests routed to rev-42 variant. That matches the validation errors.
sara (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Stop routing traffic to variant with defaults pointing to v2 by updating route->fallback to rev-41. 2) If simple route update not possible, revert catalog entry to rev-41 config. 3) Notify customers and continue to monitor. Who can run the route update?
matt (eng-runtime): I can run the route update. Will do safe canary fallback to rev-41 across the lowest-latency cluster first. Command (admin CLI):```bash
rwd admin route update --model instruct-light --variant default --fallback rev-41 --dry-run=false
```
sara (oncall): Execute and post logs here. Also set temp alert suppression for noisy validators after mitigation to avoid alert storms.
matt (eng-runtime): Executing now. ETA ~30s.
matt (eng-runtime): Done. Route update returned 200. Verifying traffic shift...
matt (eng-runtime): Traffic shift started. Current routing table snippet:```yaml
- model: instruct-light
  variant: default
  active_revision: rev-42
  fallback: rev-41
  route_policy: latency-first
```
sara (oncall): We're still seeing some errors, maybe in-flight requests to containers with mismatched tokenizer. Jun, can you trigger a rolling restart for tasks pinned to rev-42? That should flush any cached tokenizer instances.
jun (eng-sre): On it. Rolling restart started for cluster-us-east-1 group instruct-light/rev-42. Command:```bash
rwd infra restart --cluster us-east-1 --service instruct-light:rev-42 --grace=30s
```
sara (oncall): Laura, can you send a short note to affected customers: let them know we're mitigating routing and expect full recovery within 10-15 mins.
laura (cs): Sent. Message: "We're rolling back routing for your model variant due to tokenizer mismatch; you may see intermittent garbled responses for up to 15 minutes. We'll update when resolved."
matt (eng-runtime): Errors trending down. 500s per minute from 180 -> 12 in last 3 minutes. Token validation failures dropped similarly.
jun (eng-sre): Rolling restart mostly complete. No restart failures. Remaining tasks draining in 40s.
sara (oncall): Good. PD notes: acknowledged by sara, mitigated routing change executed by matt, restart done by jun. I'll keep PD open until stable for 30m.
incident-bot: PD-67890 status: acknowledged -> mitigation underway.
laura (cs): CS: customers acknowledged the notice and appreciate the quick response. One asked for RCA. We'll need a short summary post-mitigation.
matt (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: CI job that promoted catalog accidentally merged a defaults override from a staging branch that introduced `tokenizer: byte_bpe_v2` into the manifest. Promotion pipeline lacked a validation gate for tokenizer-version compatibility with pinned runtime revision.
sara (oncall): Action items: - matt to revert catalog default or add validation gate (P0 short-term) - eng-automation to add tokenizer-consistency check in promotion pipeline (P1) - cs to prepare customer-facing RCA (P1)
matt (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR to add a pre-promotion check and create rollback patch for the catalog entry. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/intern/catalog/merge/PR-512
ops-handoff-bot: Handoff to next oncall (tomorrow) scheduled. Next oncall: "alex (oncall)". Handoff notes: PD-67890 mitigated routing; monitor for 30m; follow PR-512 until merged.
sara (oncall): Dropping summary for incident log: "10:12 UTC PD-67890: catalog promotion introduced tokenizer default incompatible with runtime; mitigated by updating route fallback and rolling restart; customer impact limited to 3 accounts; follow-up validation checks and catalog rollback PR opened." :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PD-67890 closed by sara at 2024-10-05T10:48:20Z (mitigated, follow-ups assigned).
ops-handoff-bot: Recording follow-ups: ["PR-512: add tokenizer compatibility check", "Catalog rollback patch to pin defaults to rev-41", "CS RCA draft"]
sara (oncall): Thanks team. If anything else pops up I'll re-open thread. :thanks:
